760820101.text: #What is it, {M#brother}{F#sister}? Is there anything else you want to ask?

760141701.text: Whoa! Did this guy get even bigger than before?

760141702.text: Hehe, of course. After eating all those Lakkaberries that I worked hard to find, His Majesty the Tsar is now even plumper and chubbier than you are, Paimon.

760141703.text: Hey! Cut it out with the weird comparisons!

760141704.text: #Whoa! It seems to have gotten energized all of a sudden... Or should I say, excited, when it saw you, {NICKNAME}.

760141705.text: Looks like it wants to challenge you... Hah, is it feeling sore that you beat it black and blue the last time?

760141707.text: Be careful. It's much stronger than it was last time.

760141709.text: There's no need to indulge its whims, really. You can accept its challenge whenever you feel like it.

760141710.text: It's under my protection now, so it will listen to what I say.

760141712.text: You say this like it's your pet dog or something... Wait, aren't crabs sitting down all the time to begin with?

760820301.text: Tell me about the Conch Gang...

760820302.text: #Hmm? You wanna learn about us, {M#brother}{F#sister}? Sure. You're already a friend of ours, anyway.

760820303.text: We're like a... Hmm, a mutual aid and coordination organization for like-minded people of similar age. It's a shame that you're too old to join us, but...

760820304.text: If you should ever need help with anything in Nasha Town while I'm around and able, just call on me!

760820501.text: She'll be taking a long break, I imagine...

760820502.text: Hmm? So you've met her already? I never heard her mention taking time off... Ah well, that can wait.

760820602.text: Oh, don't worry. She's super reliable. Trust in Maite, and set your worries aside!

760140103.text: Paimon's a bit worried about that Maite girl. Let's go check on her when we're free!

760141401.text: #What is it, {M#brother}{F#sister}? Is there anything else you want to ask?

760141403.text: *sigh* It looks scary, but it's always been gentle. It'll probably return to normal now that the stone's gone.

760141404.text: But for now, let's leave it to hide away and reflect on its actions. Manipulated or not, what's done is done, and it still hurt all those little crabs.

760141405.text: Just like that bad governor who went up against Reed Miller while under the mirror's spell — excuses don't change the fact that you have to right wrongs with action.

760141407.text: Hehe, that's the st{RUBY#[D]Twardowska's Stone}one of desire, an item that can manipulate human hearts... Hmm, at least I think that's the name Big Sis Hidimbi mentioned?

760141408.text: *ahem* A—Anyway, it's something that fell out of the skies, like that giant rock over where the Frostmoon Scions live. Since it flew away, we should be safe now.

760141410.text: #Hmm? You wanna learn about us, {M#brother}{F#sister}? Sure. You're already a friend of ours, anyway.

760141411.text: We're like a... Hmm, a mutual aid and coordination organization for like-minded people of similar age. It's a shame that you're too old to join us, but...

760141412.text: If you should ever need help with anything in Nasha Town while I'm around and able, just call on me!

760141414.text: Oh, you mean that purple-haired priestess. She hasn't made a move against us yet, so at least she's not our enemy — for now. We should try to stay out of her business as much as possible, though.

760141415.text: Curiosity can prove deadly. Big Sis Katya also warned against making contact with those Frostmoon weirdos, and for good reason — even a master thief like myself was almost caught and sacrificed to their Moon Goddess once.

760141417.text: Yeah, those folks are really creepy. I've heard that they take blood from different people and... Ugh, just thinking about it gives me the chills. Let's leave it at that.

760141418.text: Fortunately, the one who caught me was just a naive little girl. She agreed to let me go after I told her a few stories. Otherwise...

760141419.text: I—I wasn't scared, really. A master thief never gets scared! Just a word of advice for you, though — stay away from them.

760141420.text: Ah, right, I almost forgot about the informant I promised you details about earlier. All that I learned about the Frostmoon Scions, I got from Big Sis Hidimbi.

760141421.text: If you wanna find her... Well, I think she's still around Nasha Town. Ask around and you should find out.
